spellbook.finance/limitations: A buyer is matched by shipping address, then by the marketplace's buyer hash, then by name and ZIP. Two people at one address count as one buyer, and one buyer who moved counts as two.
unkeyedOrders counts orders with no address, hash or name. They count as first orders and never match a buyer.
Every overview count covers orders from overview.historyStart onward. An order SpellBook never synced is absent from every count.

truncated true means the seller has more orders than the read scans, so every count is a lower bound. buyerListTruncated true means buyerList holds the first 500 repeat buyers by order count, then spend.
spendUsd and the spend shares sum order subtotals. They exclude shipping, tax and marketplace fees, so they are not revenue or profit.
A recipient's afterOrders count only orders placed at least 4 days after the free card was packed, so an order placed while the card was in the mail does not count.
came_back records that a later order happened. It does not show that the free card caused it, and the response carries no comparison group of buyers who got no card.
Names are the marketplace display or packing slip names the seller already sees. The response carries no street, city, ZIP, email or address hash, and buyerId means nothing outside this response.

description: Read which of the signed-in seller's buyers ordered more than once, across every channel SpellBook syncs orders from, and what happened after a free card shipped in an order. Returns overview counts and shares, weekly returning-order shares overall and per channel, buyerList with each repeat buyer's display name, channels, order count, spend and first and last order dates, and recipients with each free card recipient's prior and later orders and a status of came_back, bought_before or first_order. Call it when a seller asks who their repeat customers are, how many buyers come back, which buyers buy on more than one marketplace, or what free card recipients did next. It reads every workspace the seller belongs to and takes no input.
name: spellbook_repeat_buyers
